description: Test file for the BiMultimap data structure in the 'selectors' package, focusing on label and selector associations, including test cases for various association scenarios, updates, deletions, and consistency checks.

classes.name: useOnceSelector
classes.description: A wrapper for pkglabels.Selector that allows it to be used only once, panicking if used more than once.

methods.name: useOnce
methods.description: Creates a useOnceSelector that wraps a given pkglabels.Selector.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Checks if the selector matches given labels; panics if used more than once.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Returns whether the selector is empty.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns string representation of the selector.

methods.name: DeepCopySelector
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the selector.

methods.name: RequiresExactMatch
methods.description: Checks if the selector requires an exact match for a label.
